examples.title: The signature value to counter time-stamp, with a key check

description: Read-only RFC 5652 report of ONE CMS SignedData (.p7s / .p7m / .p7b, CMS or PKCS7 PEM, or a PDF /Contents): version, content type, attached content length (null = detached), digest algorithms, the embedded certificates (subject / issuer / serial), CRL and OCSP counts, and every signer — identifier (issuer + serial or key id), algorithms, signing time as CLAIMED, ESS signing-certificate, CMSAlgorithmProtection, signed and unsigned attributes (oid, name, value count), counter time-stamp count and the signature value as hex (what a counter time-stamp stamps: fields:['signerInfos.signature'], hash it, create_timestamp_request digestHex). `signerCertificate` (+ `signerIndex`, and `content` for a signer without signed attributes) adds signerSignature.valid — ONE signer against ONE key, a key check and NOT the verdict: verify_cms judges trust, digests, time-stamps and revocation. Trailing bytes are refused unless allowTrailingData:true; BER producers need encodingRules:'ber'. Refuses: NOT_FOUND for a signerIndex past the last signer, PKI_* for an unreadable structure. Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary', fields:[…].

allowSha1.description: Accept or produce SHA-1 signatures (legacy material you already trust). Default false: refused with PKI_CRYPTO_ALGORITHM_REFUSED on read, VALIDATION_ERROR on write.

allowTrailingData.description: Ignore bytes after the ContentInfo (the zero padding of a PDF /Contents). Default false: trailing bytes are PKI_ASN1_TRAILING_DATA.

content.description: The detached content, for a signer WITHOUT signed attributes (such a signer signs the content itself); ignored otherwise: exactly one of text / base64 / path.

base64.description: The detached content, for a signer WITHOUT signed attributes (such a signer signs the content itself); ignored otherwise as base64 bytes (≤ 128 MiB decoded). Exclusive with text / path.

path.description: Relative path of a file inside the sandbox (any extension, ≤ 1 GiB). Exclusive with text / base64.

text.description: The detached content, for a signer WITHOUT signed attributes (such a signer signs the content itself); ignored otherwise as UTF-8 text. Exclusive with base64 / path.

encodingRules.description: 'der' (strict X.690 DER, default) or 'ber' (indefinite / non-minimal lengths and constructed strings, as legacy CMS producers write).

fields.description: Dot-paths to keep after verbosity (arrays map over elements); unmatched paths land in _meta.unmatchedFields.

limits.description: Raise pkinative's 22 named security bounds for this call (trusted input only; absent keys keep the engine defaults). A value above an operator ceiling (PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_INPUT_BYTES, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_KDF_ITERATIONS, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_PATHS_EXPLORED) is LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED; describe_engine lists the defaults and the ceilings.

maxAttributes.description: The attributes of one attribute set. Default 256.

maxBerSegments.description: The segments joined from one BER constructed string. Default 10000.

maxChainLength.description: The certificates one certification path may hold. Default 10.

maxCmsCertificatesAndCrls.description: The certificates and revocation entries one SignedData carries. Default 1024.

maxDepth.description: The nesting depth of constructed values. Default 64.

maxExtensions.description: The extensions of one certificate or request. Default 256.

maxGeneralNames.description: The GeneralName entries of one field. Default 10000.

maxInputBytes.description: The size of one DER input, or the length of one PEM text. Default 67108864.

maxIntegerBytes.description: The content length of one INTEGER converted to a bigint. Default 8192.

maxKdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iteration count honoured in one derivation. Default 10000000.

maxNameAttributes.description: The attributes of one distinguished name. Default 1024.

maxNodes.description: The number of values decoded from one input. Default 200000.

maxOcspSingleResponses.description: The SingleResponse entries of one OCSP response. Default 256.

maxOidBytes.description: The content length of one OBJECT IDENTIFIER. Default 256.

maxPathsExplored.description: The candidate paths explored while building one (the RFC 5280 §6 work bound). Default 1000.

maxPemBlocks.description: The blocks read from one PEM text. Default 10000.

maxPkcs12Bags.description: The SafeBags read from one PKCS#12, across every SafeContents. Default 4096.

maxPkcs12KdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iterations one PKCS#12 costs in total. Default 10000000.

maxPolicies.description: The policies or policy mappings of one extension. Default 1024.

maxPolicyNodes.description: The live nodes of the RFC 5280 valid_policy_tree. Default 4096.

maxRevokedCertificates.description: The entries walked in one CRL revokedCertificates list. Default 1000000.

maxSignerInfos.description: The signers of one SignedData. Default 64.

pemMode.description: 'strict' (RFC 7468 exactly, default) or 'lax' (tolerates whitespace, line length and RFC 1421 headers).

signedData.description: The CMS SignedData (CMS / PKCS7 PEM, or DER: .p7s .p7m .p7b): exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path.

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

signerCertificate.description: The certificate to check ONE signer's signature against: exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path. A valid signature is a key check, NOT trust: verify_cms is the verdict.

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

signerIndex.description: Which signer the signature check targets (encoded order; NOT_FOUND past the last).

strict.description: Escalate the first engine warning to a PKI_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error instead of listing it in diagnostics[].

name: inspect_cms

outputSchema.description: Structured SignedData report. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

certificates.description: The embedded certificates (a claim by whoever assembled the message).

contentLength.description: Bytes of the encapsulated content; null when the signature is detached.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal concerns the engine raised (PKI_DIAG_*, de-duplicated, at most 200; explain_code explains one).

diagnosticsTruncated.description: true when distinct diagnostics beyond the 200 listed were dropped.

algorithmProtection.description: CMSAlgorithmProtection (RFC 6211), or null when the signer did not include one.

signature.description: The signature value as hex — what a counter time-stamp stamps (hash it, then create_timestamp_request digestHex).

signedAttributes.description: null when the signer has no signed attributes (the signature is then over the content itself).

signingCertificate.description: The ESS signingCertificate (v1) or signingCertificateV2 attribute: version and certIds (hashAlgorithm, certHash hex, issuerSerial).

signingTime.description: The time the signer CLAIMS (ISO 8601); nothing vouches for it.

timeStampTokens.description: Counter time-stamps (id-aa-signatureTimeStampToken) among the unsigned attributes.

signerSignature.description: The signature check asked for with signerCertificate: ONE signer against ONE key. A key check, not the verdict (verify_cms).

title: Inspect CMS SignedData (RFC 5652 report, signers, attributes, signature values)
